Come back to Ensomi and stay on this screen
麦克风听不到声音：音乐还在放吗？
The microphone hears nothing. Is the music still playing?
What was shared is not a song. Share the song itself.
没有等到可用的音频，会话已停止。仅支持 MP3。请等下载完成后再分享。网易云音乐保存为受保护格式的歌曲无法使用。
No usable audio arrived, so the session stopped. Only MP3 works. Let the download finish before sharing. A song NetEase saved in its protected format cannot be used.
发现了这首歌的 .ncm 文件：它采用了 Ensomi 无法使用的受保护格式。请试试能下载为 MP3 的歌曲。
A .ncm file was found for this song: it is in a protected format that Ensomi cannot use. Try a song that downloads as an MP3.
The chart model is not installed. Install it from the Library, then try again.
The chart could not be made.
同步没有锁定，不会凭猜测加入
Sync never locked, so the game does not join at a guess. The music in the room may be another recording, such as a live version, or may have stopped.
The microphone could not be used.
歌已经放完了，来不及加入
The song in the room ended before the game could join.
The game was left. It can join the music again while the song plays.
系统关闭了应用，这次会话丢失了
The system closed the app and this session was lost. Start again.
Follow these steps yourself while the music plays. Ensomi waits for your share.
Used on this device to line up with the music. Microphone audio is not saved or uploaded.
Finds the MP3 you downloaded so Ensomi can make its chart.
Open app settings if access is blocked
Install the chart model from the Library, then share the song again.
This share does not name a song. Share the song itself from NetEase Cloud Music.
Allow microphone and music access, then share the song again.
In NetEase, use Recognize Music (听歌识曲) while the music keeps playing.
Download the recognised song as MP3 and wait until it finishes. Only MP3 works; NetEase’s protected format (.ncm) cannot be used.
In NetEase, tap Share and choose Ensomi. Your share shows what to do next. Keep the music playing and stay in Ensomi while it lines up.
NetEase Cloud Music is not installed. Install it to follow these steps.
NetEase Cloud Music could not open. Open it yourself and follow these steps.
Ready. Share the song to Ensomi again to start.
链接没有提供可匹配的歌曲名称，会话已停止。请从网易云音乐分享单曲；分享内容会包含歌名和歌手。
The link did not provide a name to match, so the session stopped. Share the song from NetEase Cloud Music; its share includes the song name and artist.
